jobs.title: New Business Manager
jobs.description: Our company Surfer is an AI Visibility Platform that helps marketing teams become the definitive answer wherever their buyers search - across Google and AI search. The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form. Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs. Surfer is part of Positive Group - a fast-growing tech group specializing in B2B SaaS products that help marketing teams grow smarter. The group brings together several brands around a common ambition: to become the European benchmark in MarTech. With around 400 employees based in France, Germany, Italy, and Poland, Positive supports customers in 80+ countries. We’re a remote-first company , but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland where the magic happens (and coffee never runs out ☕). About the role We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process." On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side: working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn. You will be responsible for: Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting. Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies. Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency or at a company selling into agencies. Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting. Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs). No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing. Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that. Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools (we use HubSpot). Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above). Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience. What we offer: We build the team around experts and stay out of their way. That starts with the basics: a monthly base of approximately $2,800–$3,500 USD paid via a B2B contract - the standard self-employed/contractor setup for our EU-based team - plus a bonus system. We take care of the things that matter outside the work itself - your health, your rest, the setup that lets you work well, and the chance to sharpen your craft. Everything else follows from how we operate: trust over control, outcomes over hours. Location and Remote Work: We’re a remote-first company , but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland.

jobs.description: 💸 Up to USD 50,000 salary on a full time, contractor contract 🌎 Fully remote role with working hours aligned to US Eastern Time. 🤝 Account-management role with real responsibility for client operating clarity, stakeholder context, and systems/process handoffs. ✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment 💻 Modern hardware, AI-enabled workflows, Airtable/no-code tools, and collaborative team support. 🏋️‍♀️ Access to benefits (country dependent 🌎 ) Who We Are At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients. Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation. Embracing Future-Facing Technology Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge! About The Role We are hiring an account manager to own the client operating rhythm around Storm Ideas' Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design work. This is a high-accountability client relationship role. You will be responsible for keeping client context, stakeholder needs, open questions, risks, follow-ups, and next steps clear across work that is often messy, fast-moving, and operationally complex. The selected candidate will help launch the initial SAP S/4HANA platform and then own the ongoing evolution of Order-to-Cash capabilities for years to come. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the automotive, electric vehicle, or discrete manufacturing industries , particularly those with expertise in SAP Vehicle Management System (VMS) and SAP Variant Configuration (VC/Advanced Variant Configuration) . Define end-to-end solution architecture aligned with enterprise business requirements and SAP best practices. Provide functional leadership for SAP SD, VMS, and VC-related projects, assessments, enhancements, and transformation initiatives. Drive standardization, process simplification, and adoption of SAP S/4HANA capabilities. Establish scalable architecture supporting direct-to-consumer, dealer, fleet, and aftermarket business models. Lead design decisions for integrated customer, order, vehicle, and fulfillment processes. Familiarity with SOX requirements for finance systems, ideally in a pre-IPO or recently public-company environment. Comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment building a system rather than maintaining one. We are expanding our core engineering team to support contributions to the Splice codebase on the Canton Network, a next-generation privacy-preserving distributed ledger being adopted by major market infrastructure providers globally. Maintain high standards for code quality, test coverage, and documentation in a codebase where correctness is critical. Solid understanding of distributed systems: consensus mechanisms, fault tolerance, eventual consistency, and partition handling. Comfortable working with gRPC, Protobuf, and service-oriented architectures. Soft Skills: Communicates complex technical concepts clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, to technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrates a high degree of autonomy, accountability, and ownership for delivering outcomes. Provides and receives constructive feedback professionally, viewing code reviews and technical discussions as opportunities for collaboration and continuous improvement. Thrives in distributed teams by proactively sharing context, documenting decisions, and working effectively in asynchronous environments. Great opportunities for personal and professional development, as well as the chance to change the way the business works in the financial world. jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Remote or San Francisco Bay Area (Preferred) Format: Full-time The Mission Athena is building the world's first AI tutor that teaches instead of waiting to be asked. We believe every student deserves a tutor that adapts to them, not the other way around. AI will become the foundation of personalized education, giving every student access to the kind of guidance that today only a small percentage of students can afford. Today's AI helps students find answers. Athena helps students learn. Our vision is a world where every student has access to a tutor that understands how each student learns. Athena notices when they're struggling. It knows when to encourage, when to challenge, and when to explain differently. That's the future we're building. We've already launched our first product and are working closely with students across the U.S. The biggest lesson so far is simple: students don't want another chatbot or another video. They want something that understands where they are, guides them toward what's next, keeps them motivated, and makes learning genuinely enjoyable. All-in-one education wasn't designed around the student. It's a collection of disconnected tools: students bounce between YouTube, ChatGPT, practice platforms, tutoring services, and static materials, stitching together their own learning experience. The best YouTube videos still teach everyone the same way. AI chatbots wait for students to ask the right questions. The best tutors don't. Students need software that understands what they know, what they don't know, and what should happen next. Athena combines frontier AI with thoughtful product design and learning science to create a tutor that's always available, deeply personalized, and genuinely enjoyable to learn with. We are an incubated company out of super{set} , a San Francisco venture studio that conceives, funds, and builds AI-native companies from formation through scale. Athena is founded by Kize, whose educational content has reached more than 250,000 learners. The product is already in students' hands, and we're now building the platform that can scale that experience far beyond one creator. The Role We're looking for our first Founding Engineer who will define Athena as much as the founder does and help build both the product and the technical foundation at Athena. You'll spend more time debating product decisions with the founder to turn ambitious ideas into software students genuinely love using (instead of implementing tickets). You'll help define our engineering culture, shape the product roadmap, and establish what AI-native learning should look like. This role goes well beyond engineering execution. Great education products sit at the intersection of engineering, product, design, psychology, and learning science. Every engineering decision changes how someone learns. We're looking for someone who wants to build a great company, not just write code. How We Build We care as much about how we build as what we build. Product taste and good design matter. We believe great design keeps students engaged. We obsess over the moments most teams ignore: the pacing of an explanation, the moment encouragement appears, the friction between opening the app and making progress. We want Athena to feel less like educational software and more like a product students genuinely look forward to using. If Athena feels like "another AI app," we've failed. Students' outcomes win every argument. Every decision starts with one question: does this genuinely help students learn? Ship early and learn fast. We believe real student behavior is more valuable than internal debate. We ship, observe, learn, and iterate relentlessly. AI should raise the quality bar. We use AI throughout our development process to move faster, but never to lower our standards. AI should amplify craftsmanship, not replace it.
